BUG FIXED in /Users/kristinarash/DEV/TypeSafe_Sandbox/video_check/run_llm.py, haiku branch of call(). This change is uncommitted and the orchestrator has to commit it. The diff adds one cmd line, "--setting-sources", "", "--strict-mcp-config",, between the --tools "" line and the --system-prompt line, plus a two-line comment. SYSTEM, USER_SUFFIX, RULE, model_state, parse, the codex branch and the model id are all byte-identical.

Why the fix was needed: the headless claude -p call loaded the user's settings, which brought in SessionStart hooks, plugins, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and memory. That added about 110k tokens of extra context to every Haiku call and broke the registered condition (state is the claim and passage only, no outside knowledge). Evidence: a throwaway-prompt probe took 239 s and used about 111k tokens as written, against 23 s and about 480 tokens with the flags. Moving the cwd to /tmp alone did not help (still about 110k tokens). With the flags, a probe that asked Haiku to dump its context showed only the built-in Claude Code environment block, the user email line and the date. No CLAUDE.md, memory or Baylor content got through. That leftover boilerplate cannot be removed without --bare, and --bare needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which is not set.
The smoke-test row for rea000 was produced before the fix, under the contaminated setup. I deleted runs/haiku.jsonl before the full run, so all 140 rows share the one fixed setup.

Flag for the codex arm: the codex branch of call() is unchanged. codex exec may also load the user's global config or AGENTS.md. I did not check this. It is worth the same context-size check before its results are trusted.
